person_note: The book has sustained base sections in two grammatical persons. Jessica’s chapters use participating first-person narration, confirmed by numerous quotes and two authorized excerpts. Dr. Shields’s chapters sustain story-specific second-person narration addressed to Jessica, reflected in q03681, q03684, q03689, q03699, and q03709. The publisher’s authors’ guide and multiple independent structural descriptions explicitly confirm that these chapter types alternate. Universal “we” and “you” aphorisms were treated as non-base rather than evidence of additional narrators. No credible contrary structure remains.
